moments.action: Night: two figures cross a lit footbridge over a highway past green-arrow and red-X lane signs. Cut to Bank and Lynn sitting side by side in a dark red-seated cabin, both staring ahead, not speaking.
Daylight abroad: a gull on a railing against a soft-focus harbour skyline, then a wide platform silhouette where Bank and Lynn stand well apart with their bags, a bridge and cruise liner behind them.
Framed through a stone arch, Bank and Lynn stand at a harbour railing with the opera house across the water, bags set down at their feet; they hold the same side-by-side pose for the whole long take.
Tight reverses start: Bank, low angle with the bridge behind him, talks with his head lowered; Lynn, shot over his shoulder, stays turned away and looks out at the water instead of at him.
Lynn turns into profile and answers while Bank drops his eyes further; by the end of the run she has swung further round toward him and is doing the talking.
Bank lifts his head and looks off past her; Lynn watches him, faintly frowning; Bank then settles back into still profile, facing the water rather than her.
Lynn faces the glittering water with her eyes lowered, calm and quiet; behind her Bank turns his head further away until only the back of his head is left to camera.
Wide across the harbour: Lynn, seen from behind in her striped top, stands alone watching a ferry cross in front of the opera house. Bank has dropped out of frame entirely.
